fields.total_premium: Total premium payable, including taxes and fees (printed as Total Payable)
fields.minimum_earned_premium: Minimum earned premium, as an amount or percent
fields.cyber_business_interruption: Cyber business interruption sublimit and waiting period
fields.cyber_social_engineering: Social engineering or funds transfer fraud sublimit
fields.eo_each_claim_limit: Errors and omissions each claim limit
fields.eo_retention: Errors and omissions retention or deductible
fields.eo_retroactive_date: Retroactive date for claims-made E&O coverage, or Full Prior Acts
fields.eo_defense_costs: Whether defense costs are inside or outside the E&O limit

unscored_fields.each_occurrence_limit: ambiguous on a cyber and E&O quote (per-claim limits per coverage part), not scored
unscored_fields.retention: ambiguous on a cyber and E&O quote (retentions per coverage part), not scored

proposals.description: Three carriers quoting one Cyber and Technology E&O program; two single-column quotes and one whose coverage part schedule is a two-column table.
Two carriers, no-AI-prose mode. One quote has no ransomware or social engineering cover and no AM Best rating (null cells that must show no value); the other is a two-column table.
Two carriers; one quote's coverage schedule states a social engineering sublimit that a later endorsement replaces (truth is the amended figure, the scheduled one is a decoy).
